Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring certain information to be included with health care premium billings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notices with health care premiumbillings; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning with estimates for calendar year 2005, the insurancecommissioner must annually calculate costshifting estimates thatestimate the percentage of total health benefit plan premiums chargedby health carriers in this state that reflects the statewide cost ofuncompensated health care. These annual estimates must be posted onthe web site of the office of the insurance commissioner by October 1stof the year immediately following the completed calendar year thatimmediately followed the year for which the estimate was made. (2)(a) Beginning with health benefit plan premiums billed on andafter January 1, 2008, a health carrier must, at least annually,provide the following information with its premium billing: (i) The most current costshifting estimate determined by theinsurance commissioner under subsection (1) of this section at the timeof the billing; and p. 1 HB 1717 (ii) The amount, as a percentage of the health carrier's averagepremium per member per month, of the health carrier's surplus thatexceeds the level defined in RCW 48.43.300(9)(a) as reported to theinsurance commissioner in the carrier's most recent annual report underRCW 48.43.305 at the time of billing. (b) The information required to be provided with health benefitplan premium billings under (a) of this subsection must be conspicuousand be provided in boldface type no smaller than the largest type usedto display billing information. (3) The insurance commissioner may adopt rules as necessary toimplement this section.
